title: dan dan mian
description: a yeasty and juicy Chinese dish featuring white wine in a dan dan mian form, which is a solo dinner option. the whole30-friendly recipe uses a variety of ingredients to create a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.notes: uncooked wine used to make the yeast starter

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: used for the yeast starter and dan dan mian dough

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: used for the yeast starter and dan dan mian dough

ingredients.name: yeast
ingredients.notes: active dry yeast used for the yeast starter

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: used for the dan dan mian dough

ingredients.name: dan dan mian noodles
ingredients.notes: used for the dan dan mian

instructions: combine the yeast, water, and white wine in a bowl to create the yeast starter, then let it sit for 10 minutes to become frothy.
heat the water in a pot to 9076f, then add the all-purpose flour and knead the dough for 10 minutes to create the dan dan mian dough.
let the dan dan mian dough rest for 30 minutes, then knead it again for 5 minutes.
use a rolling pin to roll out the dan dan mian dough into a thin sheet, then cut it into long strips.
cook the dan dan mian noodles according to the package instructions, then set them aside.
heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the cooked dan dan mian noodles and stir-fry them for 2 minutes.
add the yeast starter, salt, and any additional ingredients you'd like to the noodles and stir-fry them for another 2 minutes.
serve the dan dan mian hot, garnished with any desired toppings such as sesame seeds, chopped scallions, or sliced chili peppers.
adjust the seasoning as needed to taste.
